disease_label_per_paper: Acute non-hemolytic febrile transfusion reaction after HLA-selected platelet concentrate
presentation_summary: A 66-year-old woman with acute myeloid leukemia had an acute non-hemolytic transfusion reaction reported after transfusion of an HLA-selected platelet concentrate.
The reaction type in the case table was febrile, with fever and chills.
The platelet component was from a male donor and was leukoreduced by bedside filtration.
HLA antibody testing later showed patient class I and II antibodies with class I specificity including donor cognate B60; this HLA antibody workup is kept confirmatory/non-ranking.
The article analyzed acute non-hemolytic transfusion reactions separately from TRALI/dyspnea and allergic reactions.
